final: WITH f AS (SELECT ID, HGB, APTT, PT FROM Laboratory WHERE UA >= 3.9), p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(CASE WHEN APTT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL THEN APTT - PT END) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM f GROUP BY ID) SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS mean_patient_avg_hgb, AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS mean_patient_avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM p
